calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  ROUND(AVG(f.closing_value), 2) as average_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 11
  AND s.region = 'West'
  AND s.is_current = TRUE
  AND p.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

FROM fact_stock_week f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.week_ending_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
